status: read-only design review; no implementation, tests, qualification or performance claim
verdict: The proposed private, synchronous, phase-controlled reader is a plausible way to use the SAME genuine legacy CJS source guard as a callback-free physical preflight/final while retaining its full real supplied-read consume. It need not expose any reader authority or cache new source/results. Do not claim full equivalence until the exact production reader chain and direct-CJS-only reference identities below are proven and actual tests pass.
why_it_covers_real_predicates: The one unchanged inspectCanonicalSource runs in consume mode, with actual supplied reads checked against fresh trusted owner physical before and after. Source object and supplied reader remain private. Subsequent source.assertCurrent in physical mode still executes the real CJS tools.assertCurrent, CJS assertBound twice, legacy source.assertCurrent, its historical repairs/original/currentSass guards, complete project population and retained physical boundary. Its callback becomes a private physical read only; no external user callback executes during preflight/final. This preserves currentSass's stronger peer node_modules/@angular no-link and package-manifest-name checks instead of approximating them with ownerMember alone.

Consume mode invokes the same original source.assertCurrent through the same supplied reader. All original CJS callback occurrences still occur and check bytes, including distinct same-path reader/policy judgments. Pre/final are additional physical observations, not a claim that the source inspection was redone from scratch. Actual nested current-tool graph was constructed by this CJS source object and is a distinct instance from stage's successor tools graph; do not infer same node by name/path.

The original CJS object already retains its guard closures and bound observations for its lifetime. Keeping that actual private object is no new success/receipt/source/parsed-result cache. No private read, mode setter, historical bytes, or registration is exported; expose only a matching static guard node/tuple and already permitted facts snapshot. Returned node predicates must never return bytes or permit caller-provided paths.

projection_and_direct_read_proof.direct_reads: CJS inspectSource builds its own bound of admission individual REVIEW, QUALIFICATION, SOURCE_REVIEW, BOUNDARY, VERIFIER, SUCCESSOR, current handlerRef and body.patch_file, adds tools.bound, executes assertBound and separately reads REVIEW/SOURCE_REVIEW/BOUNDARY. assertBound checks supplied hash/optional size; it does NOT independently prove every one of these direct supplied reads equals physical. Some are nested-source/tool inputs too, but do not infer universal physical coverage merely from source.bound concatenation. Current body.patch_file is compatibility/rc/21x-legacy-removal-admission-original-complete.diff.
projection_and_direct_read_proof.actual_private_route: Known projection maps in packed-upstream-ledger-epoch are base/table/legacy ledger, inventory ledger+historical inventory+workflow+two title-handler files, and title owner+native registry+autocomplete subject+ledger. The above fixed admission refs and patch path do not match those mappings. In the immediate real chain, table metadataRead maps only ledger, base metadataRead maps only ledger and forwards other paths to its canonical physical boundary. Historical repair source explicitly treats its three canonical ledger/registry/roster refs as historical DATA rather than runtime member reads; current-tool guard independently requires physical equality on its own actual bounds; nested legacy readCurrent uses canonicalSourcePhysicalBoundary physical/supplied/physical. These observations support, but do not by themselves prove across every genuine calling route and arbitrary public caller, that phase-read physicality is compatible.
projection_and_direct_read_proof.hard_requirement: For each actual registered route, prove all CJS actual supplied read paths either go through a genuine physical boundary or are nonprojected and actual values are required to equal corresponding ownerMember bytes. The exact fixed direct refs must be checked separately from nested currentSass/tools physical predicates. Source CJS's private bound, current-tool evolving bound and readCurrent/boundary retained values are not a basis to infer unobserved reader mapping. If some legitimate route supplies only a qualified historical predecessor for a direct path, checked physical consume rejects a previously accepted judgment; preserve that route using explicit owned projection proof or do not enroll it. Do not blanket-assert the CJS guard independently enforced physical equality.
projection_and_direct_read_proof.arbitrary_reader_counterexample: A direct legacyRemovalOwnerContext caller can supply correct expected bytes for an admission-only direct hash-ref while physical file differs, if no other original nested guard happens to bind that same path. The original CJS direct check can accept that reference, whereas the proposed checked reader immediately rejects physical/supplied mismatch. Determine whether that input class is an intentional supported contract and whether genuine nested closure or existing outer boundary in fact also covers each specific ref; do not call this demonstrated exploit or assert it applies to all refs.

mode_and_lock: Use private immutable function references to source guard, inspector and pure metadata predicate captured as own data properties; snapshot relevant context/entry/body/proof descriptors and immutable judgments before exposing a node. Authenticate loaded inspector and relevant physical source image under established pin policy before first external callback and in appropriate final checks.

Central execute(phase): assert phase is idle/consume default and lock false; set lock before any phase assignment, set phase to requested value inside try, invoke exact captured sourceGuard synchronously, restore consume phase and clear lock in finally even on throw. A physical predicate invoked directly through an alternate plan must take the same lock. Reader checks phase is recognized; physical mode never calls actual supplied read; consume mode compares intrinsic Buffer physical-before/supplied and physical-after, returning actual correctly qualified bytes. No caller can set mode or invoke unguarded sourceGuard.

The reader must permit its expected nested calls WHILE its own phase is locked; lock only guards entry to the source operation, not every normal reader call. During physical phase the guard's nested current-tool scheduler runs with its own genuine instance; it may call the private phase reader without recursively entering source operation. During consume, a supplied callback that invokes same-source guard or its node through a second plan must reject before changing phase. Legitimate independently constructed source objects must remain independent.

Construction executes full real CJS with checked source reader in consume mode; establish the same phase/entry invariants while constructing or explicitly prohibit access to an incompletely constructed context. Preserve the caller's independent callback byte checks, not merely the CJS hash result. Mode cannot be exposed through object properties or via a returned reader closure.

Scheduler all-preflight/all-consume/all-final ordering must include actual legacy successor tools node and local stage node. SourceGuard physical final occurs after ALL source, stage, successor and later nested graph callback consumes, not merely after sourceNode.consume. Keep the larger enclosing outer boundary's own final; a local source final does not cover paths belonging only to other opaque owners or reads added after it.
stage_scope: Legacy stage bound currently merges tools.bound, stage refs and source.bound, and actualLedger may be a predecessor projection. Construct separate physical reference from the actually authenticated physical frame for ledger, not the projected expected supplied bytes; preserve supplied read against its captured projected ref and both physical before/after and final checks. Registry predecessor mapping is independently derived through tools.predecessorData and actual registry physical proof. Do not collapse duplicate CJS source judgments merely because stage bound is a path Map: SAME original sourceGuard still checks each original CJS/source expectation. Before adding new local physical sweep for every bound, prove reader-specific physical paths and safe root for each ref, including any Cyph and peer paths; the original legacy stage currently lacks an explicit final sweep for its own local bound.
targeted_controls: Use the real parent legacy context: prove initial CJS constructor callbacks execute in consume mode, then source preflight/final trigger no external supplied read. During source consume count actual source callbacks by path and compare to direct genuine CJS guard expectations; verify each distinct duplicate/path judgment, no cached success on second invocation.

A preexisting CJS-only direct admission ref drifts and is restored on first callback: cold physical reject before callback. Inject wrong provided bytes and same-callback physical mutation for top-level CJS and a nested product/currentSass/tool ref; assert the exact intended predicate and path. Later higher callback mutates source-only input: final genuine physical guard rejects after callback. Use real phase/callback evidence, not any ERR_ASSERTION.

Wrong peer package name with identical target Sass bytes, symlinked @angular or node_modules container, and symlinked peer descendant: genuine currentSass physical guard rejects in cold/final. Test only isolated fixture where no existing filesystem link is overwritten; non-destructive exact recovery must preserve unrelated files.

Product file addition/deletion and symlink placement reject exact full population; node_modules exclusion and expected no-absentPaths in this source boundary remain distinct. Exercise dynamic readCurrent/boundary retained additions if a genuine reachable operation can add them; final observes the actual retained set without a fabricated public path grant.

Test supplied predecessor ledger 70->69->68 and registry mapping through the actual owner route. Count and verify top-level fixed refs versus physical images and demonstrate how a legitimate historical-only projection would remain handled or force original route. No test should mutate/unregister private WeakMap or grant an arbitrary reader.

Nested same source node through another composed plan and direct predicate calls must fail while source preflight/consume/final locked, without changing phase or invoking external callbacks. A different genuine source instance may nest if no shared descendant active; distinguish correctly rejected shared dependency reentry. After all thrown paths, rerun successful guard proving phase restored to consume.

Fresh CJS inspector pointer poisoning, mode spoof attempt and metadata mutation before first callback and after last callback; exact recovery after child reap. Run existing targeted source/cross-frame/CLI tests and mandatory full source regressions after pin/profile and review; measure independently before making speed claims.
limits: This review does not certify implementation, a supported arbitrary reader contract, complete owner execution, physical-policy set under future changes, or speed. Current focused batch was running; no maintained code or tests were touched or run in this review.
